info.title: Facturacion SIFEN API
info.description: Electronic invoicing for Paraguay (SIFEN). Authenticate with an API key: `Authorization: Bearer sk_live_...`. Errors use `{ statusCode, message, errors? }`. Webhook payloads and signatures are described in docs/integracion/webhooks.md. Project documentation (PRD, ADRs, plan, operations) is browsable in the [guides](/docs/guides).

post.summary: Accept an invoice (FE), a credit note (NCE), a debit note (NDE), a self-invoice (AFE) or a remission note (NRE) for emission
post.description: The body is an FE unless `type` is `NCE` (credit note) or `NDE` (debit note), both associated to an approved FE whose receiver they take, or `AFE` (self-invoice: the issuer buys from a seller who is not a contribuyente; the receiver is the issuer, there is no VAT and the seller constancia is mandatory) or `NRE` (remission note: goods in transit, with the motive, the kilometres, the places, the vehicle and the carrier; items carry a quantity and no price, and the document has no totals; motive 7 only to the issuer own RUC, 2606). From the day before the active certificate expires (`CERTIFICATE_EMISSION_BLOCK_DAYS`) the request answers 422 with `code: certificate_expiring` and `notAfter`, before any number is used. A credit note answers 422 with the rule of the failed check (for example `credit-note-sum-exceeds-invoice`, 2417) before any number is used. Returns 202 once the document is persisted with its CDC; signing and transmission to SIFEN are asynchronous. With `?wait=true`, a tenant that has synchronous transmission enabled gets the response held until SIFEN settles the document (up to `SYNC_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS`, 30 s by default) and receives 200 with the final document; if the wait ends first, or the tenant has no synchronous transmission, the usual 202 comes back. Sending is still driven by the worker cycle, so the wait is bounded by `TRANSMISSION_CYCLE_INTERVAL_MS`. Retrying with the same `Idempotency-Key` and body returns the same response; the same key with another body is a 409.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters, no spaces

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description: Only `true` has an effect: hold the response for a tenant with synchronous transmission until the document is final.

200.description: Final document (only with `?wait=true` for a tenant with synchronous transmission)

post.summary: Correct a rejected document and send it again
post.description: Takes the full corrected body of a document SIFEN rejected (same shape as `POST /v1/documents`; the `type` cannot change). When the correction keeps the establishment, the point and the associated CDC and the 72 h window of the issue date is open, the document keeps its number and CDC and is queued again (`202 { document_id, cdc }` with the same ids); the previous body and SIFEN messages are kept in the correction history. Otherwise the corrected body is issued as a new document (new number, new date: the response carries the new `document_id` and `cdc`) and the old number is voided (webhook `document.number_voided`); if that voiding is refused (for example 4066) the replacement stays, the correction is recorded and the response adds `void: { status: "refused", errors }`, the same on every retry. Only a `rejected` document that was not reissued before can be corrected (409 `document_not_correctable`). Retrying with the same `Idempotency-Key` and body returns the same response; the same key with another body is a 409.

post.summary: Request the cancellation of an approved document
post.description: Asynchronous like emission: 202 once the cancellation event is stored; the worker signs it with the tenant certificate and sends it to SIFEN, and the document becomes `cancelled` (webhook `document.cancelled`) when SIFEN registers it. Only a document SIFEN holds as approved can be cancelled, within 48 hours of its approval for an FE and 168 hours for an AFE, NCE, NDE or NRE (MT v150 11.6.1, 4009 and 4010); a document with live associated documents is refused and they are listed (cancel them first, from the last to the first). A receiver having confirmed the document does not block it (NT 025). The 422 body carries `errors[0].rule` (`document-not-approved`, `cancel-window-expired`, `has-live-associated-documents`, `cancel-document-type-unsupported`, `approval-instant-unknown`) and, when SIFEN defines one, `sifenCode`. Retrying with the same `Idempotency-Key` and body returns the same response; the same key with another body is a 409.

post.summary: Name the receiver of an FE issued to an unnamed receiver
post.description: Asynchronous like the cancellation: 202 once the nomination event is stored; the worker signs it with the tenant certificate and sends it to SIFEN (NT 014, 015, 027). Only an approved FE (type 1) issued to an unnamed receiver ("Sin Nombre") can be nominated, once: a rejected nomination may be requested again. The receiver is a `taxpayer` (RUC with its check digit and taxpayer type) or a `non-taxpayer` (document type 1 to 5 and number); the operation type B2B is only for taxpayers. The 422 body carries `errors[0].rule` (`nominate-requires-fe` 4454, `document-not-approved` 4002, `nominate-receiver-named` 4469, `reason-length` or `schema`) and, when SIFEN defines one, `sifenCode`. Retrying with the same `Idempotency-Key` and body returns the same response; the same key with another body is a 409.

post.summary: Request the voiding of a range of numbers that will not be used
post.description: Asynchronous: 202 once the voiding event is stored; the worker signs it and sends it to SIFEN, and the rejected documents inside the range become `number_voided` (webhook `document.number_voided`) when SIFEN registers it. The range has at most 1000 numbers (MT v150 11.6.2, 4067), belongs to the tenant's timbrado, establishment and point (4052, 4054, 4055), holds only numbers already issued, and holds no document SIFEN may know (4065: only rejected documents and gaps can be voided) nor numbers already being voided (4066). The 422 body carries `errors[].rule`, `sifenCode` when SIFEN defines one, and the offending `numbers` for 4065. Retrying with the same `Idempotency-Key` and body returns the same response; the same key with another body is a 409.

post.summary: Register a conformity, disconformity, unawareness or receipt notice over a CDC
post.description: The tenant acts as the RECEIVER of a DE/DTE issued by someone else. Asynchronous: 202 once the event is stored; the worker signs it with the tenant certificate and sends it to SIFEN with the other events. Allowed within 45 days (configurable) of the issue date of a DE or of the approval of a DTE (`approvedAt`, NT 019), at most one event per kind (a partial conformity may precede the total one), and not after an unawareness. An event that contradicts the last one is a correction (`receiver-event-needs-correction`). The 422 body carries `errors[].rule`, `sifenCode` when SIFEN defines one and, for an expired window, the `deadline`; an event of that kind already registered is a 409. Retrying with the same `Idempotency-Key` and body returns the same response; the same key with another body is a 409.

post.summary: Correct a receiver event SIFEN approved by registering the opposite one
post.description: The body is the replacement event (same fields and CDC as `ReceiverEventRequest`) plus `correctionReason` (5 to 500 characters). Only a conformity, disconformity or unawareness SIFEN approved can be corrected: once, while it is the last conclusive event of the CDC, within 15 days (configurable) of its approval, by the opposite kind; a correction cannot be corrected. 422 `errors[].rule` names the failed rule (`correction-window-expired` carries `deadline`); a second correction is a 409. Same `Idempotency-Key` and body return the same response; another body is a 409.
